karatiya.p: [¿] (pu) CL=7 (1) A kind of bean (Cowpea Vigna Catjang). (2) Deva who is named Karatiya.
pn: Karatiya. A Yakkha, mentioned in the Āṭānāṭiyasutta as being one of the chief Yakkhas who should be invoked by followers of the Buddha when they need protection. DN.iii.204.
